title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md:121: Incorrect modulo calculation in example
description: The example calculation claims 926423932 MOD 7 = 1 yielding channel 2, but mathematically 926423932 MOD 7 = 0, so the correct channel is 1. Verified: 132346276 * 7 = 926423932 exactly (no remainder). This would mislead implementers validating their code against the example. Fix: Change line 121 from 'Step 5: Channel = 1 + (926423932 MOD 7) = 1 + 1 = 2' to 'Step 5: Channel = 1 + (926423932 MOD 7) = 1 + 0 = 1' and update 'Result: Channel 2' to 'Result: Channel 1'.
close_reason: Fixed incorrect modulo calculation in spec example: 926423932 MOD 7 = 0 (not 1), so channel = 1 (not 2). Also corrected hex representation from 0x373854FC to 0x37381B7C. The example test vector in the spec was already correct; only the step-by-step calculation needed fixing.
